recipes.name: Slow Cooker Roast Beef
ingredients_raw: 1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix

steps.text: Whisk soy sauce and soup mix together in a slow cooker until well combined. Place chuck roast into the cooker; pour in water until all but the top 1/2 inch of roast is covered. Sprinkle ground pepper over top. Cover and cook on Low until meat is tender, about 22 hours.

raw_recipe.headline: Slow Cooker Roast Beef
raw_recipe.description: This slow cooker roast beef recipe requires only 4 ingredients and almost zero hands-on time. Just season, cook, and wait until the next day!

video.description: See how to make a tasty pot roast with just five ingredients.

review.reviewBody: Since I had a sirloin tip roast that certainly wouldn't need 22 hours in the slow cooker, I only cooked it about 7-1/2 hours and it was done perfectly. I set the roast on a bed of cremini mushrooms, used beefy onion soup mix, since that's what I had in the pantry, only 2 T. of soy sauce to avoid this being too salty, a bay leaf, and just a mere cup of water. The house smelled wonderful and the roast was delicious and flavorful with a rich au jus. We're looking forward to having the leftovers as French Dip sandwiches!

Excellent recipe, but it did NOT take 22 hours! I prepared a 3 pound chuck roast using low sodium soy sauce and the soup mix. It was ready in about 6 hours, and it was AMAZING! Fork tender, with mashed potatoes, au jus, and creamed carrots. It was definitely a hit tonight, especially since my aging mom just moved in with me and she said she hadn’t had roast beef in 30 years. I don’t know how true that is, but we will definitely be making this one again. So easy and delicious!

This was such an easy and delicious recipe for my large family. I cooked 6 lbs. of chuck roast in my 7 qt. Crock-Pot. I did not change any of the other ingredient amounts, although I didn’t have a packet of French onion soup mix, so I used a packet of beef onion. I suspect almost any of the Lipton dry soup packets would work. I did use low-sodium soy sauce, as well. I started it at 8:30 in the evening and let it cook until 6:30 the next night, before serving it over mashed potatoes. It was fall-apart tender, and everyone (11 peeps) loved it!
only cooked for 4 hours & it was still perfect!

My roast weighed a mere 1.85 lbs. I used 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp black pepper, and 1/2 pkg dry onion soup mix. I placed the roast on a bed of button mushrooms, and added 1 1/4 cup low sodium beef broth. I cooked on low for 8 hours - my husband said Yum!”

Tasted great! Seasoned and floured 3 lb pot roast and cooked on stove top. Cooked on low 4 hours. Added carrots, potato, onions and mushrooms last 30 minutes. Used low sodium soy sauce and beefy onion soup mix. Because I floured the roast before searing it so it made into a creamy gravy as it cooked. Was absolutely delicious . Not salty at all.

Tasty! Did a bit less than the amount of soy sauce , used low sodium. Beefy onion soup mix, cooked from frozen on high for about 6 hours, then low for 2 more- came out great. Added some frozen carrots about half way through and made gravy with some of the liquid by adding corn starch and cold water. I'll definitely make this again, but can't imagine 22 hours cook time- seems way too long.

So delicious and super easy! I added a box of unsalted beef stock and 3 whole cloves of garlic. Cooked on low for 12 hours for a 3-1/2 pound rump roast. Tender tender tender. Added quartered potatoes last couple of hours. The juice made a yummy au jus.

I wanna see a picture of a chuck roast that slow-cooked for 22 hours. I’m not being snarky, I’m really serious I’m making one right now with 1 can cream of mushroom and one can of beef gravy. Plan on cooking it on low for 7-8. Hours,( I think it’s 3 pounds. I browned the roast first and then scraped the pan into the slow cooker.
I use beef broth instead of water, I usually add carrots and potatoes. I’ve never cooked it 22 hours, 8-10 maximum on high.

My husband asked if we could have this more often because it was so tender and the gravy was awesome! He is not usually fond of the cheaper cuts of meat, so that says a lot! I used the ingredients as listed but only cooked on low for 8 hours. Thickened the gravy with cornstarch and my immersible blender wand.

I have never left a comment but I had to here. Worst recipe ever. I followed exactly even tho it calls to cook for 22 hours! How stupid of me to actually do that. Besides the fact that it was so dry and salty it burned. Total waste of a $30 chuck roast. I encourage you to look for a different recipe. Nasty!!!

Somewhere around $30 for 3 pounds of chuck roast. Shrinks but serves 4 to 6, depending on serving, around $7 per person just for the meat. Still, easy meal when cooked in a slow cooker but almost 22 hours until ready.
This isn't roast beef, it's a pot roast.

I cook all of my chuck roasts for no more than 6 hrs on low. I also disagree with your ingredients. I do not use soy (I use coconut amino acid instead), anything that comes prepackaged (like your onion soup) is never used with my roasts. Actually, my roasts are slow cooked with three ingredients: roast, Kerrygold butter (1/2 stick), and coconut amino acid (1/4 cup). Comes out perfect every time.
I’ve been using this recipe for years! Add roast carrots and potatoes with this meal and top it all with beef gravy, now you’re in business!
We have been making this super easy recipe for years and it's a winner every time. My grandson loves it and wants it every time he comes home from college. We generally make 5-7 lbs each time.
I made it with neck meat and it was great. I will make it again.
